DISCUSS: Chomp Up the Charts: Florida Jumps to No. 8 in AP, Coaches Polls
Florida’s 52-28 win over No. 4 Ole Miss sent the Gators up 13 spots in the AP Top 25 and 14 in the Coaches Poll. They’re No. 8 in both.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/chomp-up-the-charts-florida-jumps-to-no-8-in-ap-coaches-polls
By Brenden Martin. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
